scope: Completed web RAG+Notes expansion only; semantic generated-memory/QA acceptance remains separate

snapshot.boundary: Stored textual trajectory completeness; not generated-memory semantic certification.

expansion.wall_scope: sum of sequential publication stages; excludes startup/cloning/inherited cost; not fresh cold build or process wall

cost_ledger.failure_count_scope: llm_failed_calls counts logged request failures, not parse/semantic failure; joint parse failures and Notes repair requests are separate observed records, with their request costs already included in totals; missing legacy traces are not proof of absence
cost_ledger.embedding_call_scope: logged embedding operations; inherited SDK permits transport retries, whose individual attempts are not logged
cost_ledger.ledger_coverage: observed non-query requests in inherited own-history ledger; not proof all historical work was logged

quality_boundary: Exact full source and slice mapping, nonempty Notes and finite aligned vector rows, preserved inherited Notes/vectors. Not semantic quality or downstream QA certification.

native_note_fallback_review.observed_issue: Primary and repair responses remain invalid JSON with unescaped quoted size strings and array content instead of the required string.
native_note_fallback_review.transport_finish: Both stop; no transport failure or output-budget truncation
native_note_fallback_review.published_procedure: Native deterministic fallback contains first8 of11 annotated actions, omitting the later order-navigation and final size-answer action.
native_note_fallback_review.published_hint: Native deterministic fallback preserves recorded outcome failure, start URL, action count and first action.
native_note_fallback_review.source_retained: Complete12-state trajectory and source slices retained; fallback Notes do not establish full workflow coverage.
native_note_fallback_review.decision: Preserve native fallback, recorded costs and limited-quality label; no rerun or runtime/scoring modification.
